quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا
وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ حُطَٰمًۭا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ
ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ
لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَٰهُ أُجَاجًۭا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ
ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ
وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ
وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

parent_channels.name: P1 Decisive Impact as Material and Social Redistribution

subchannels.name: Solid height becomes dispersed matter
subchannels.scene_or_process: A severe arrival strikes the lower plane, agitates a solid elevation, grinds it, and broadcasts it as fine airborne matter.
subchannels.active_motifs: severe descending event `quranic:root_001675:B002/m01`; audible impact `quranic:root_001675:B004/m01`; lower terrestrial plane `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; violent shaking `quranic:root_000541:B001/m01`; raised solid mass `quranic:root_000217:B001/m01`; crumbling and mixing `quranic:root_000115:B003/m01`; fine dispersed dust `quranic:root_001576:B002/m01`; scattering and spreading `quranic:root_000083:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The event is not merely announced; it behaves like an impact process. Ground oscillation removes the mountain's compact, elevated integrity, crumbling and mixing it until the former mass can be spread as airborne particles.

subchannels.name: Vertical reversal becomes ranked approach
subchannels.scene_or_process: Positions are lowered or elevated, sorted into three classes, polarized by side, and resolved through precedence into privileged nearness.
subchannels.active_motifs: descent after elevation `quranic:root_000426:B001/m01`; physical raising `quranic:root_000582:B001/m01`; elevation of rank `quranic:root_000582:B002/m01`; threefold number `quranic:root_000203:B001/m01`; class or type `quranic:root_000652:B004/m01`; left side `quranic:root_000772:B001/m01`; ill omen `quranic:root_000772:B003/m01`; blessing `quranic:root_001698:B001/m01`; right side `quranic:root_001698:B002/m01`; precedence in a race `quranic:root_000671:B001/m01`; royal intimates `quranic:root_001212:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Physical reversal supplies the passage's grammar of status. Three classes are not a static catalog: side assigns auspice, precedence functions like a race, and the foremost finish not merely ahead but inside the circle of a sovereign's intimates.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A single unavoidable occurrence breaks prior stability and reallocates both physical and social position.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 56:1-11 moves from the وقوع of the event through earth-shaking and mountain dispersal to lowering, raising, threefold sorting, precedence, and nearness.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The vertical mechanics of impact become a social mechanism: compact height is pulverized while rank is lowered, raised, sided, raced, and brought into royal proximity.

parent_channels.name: P1 Reward as a Protected, Circulating Court

subchannels.name: Cohorts installed in a face-to-face court
subchannels.scene_or_process: Differently sized temporal cohorts enter a protected garden-court and take ordered, interwoven seats facing one another.
subchannels.active_motifs: royal intimates `quranic:root_001212:B004/m01`; tree-screened garden `quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`; good and easeful condition `quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`; gathered cohort `quranic:root_000204:B001/m01`; temporal priority `quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`; small number `quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`; later cohort `quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`; settled couch or throne `quranic:root_000697:B011/m01`; interwoven construction `quranic:root_001658:B001/m01`; reclining support `quranic:root_001678:B004/m01`; mutual facing `quranic:root_001198:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Nearness opens into a formal social interior. Earlier and later cohorts are counted, then placed on tightly constructed supports in mutual view, turning blessed enclosure into an ordered audience rather than private isolation.

subchannels.name: Perpetual service and drink without drain
subchannels.scene_or_process: Enduring young attendants circulate open drinking vessels from a running source while both bodily impairment and exhaustion of supply are blocked.
subchannels.active_motifs: circuit around a center `quranic:root_000957:B001/m01`; young servant `quranic:root_001683:B004/m01`; enduring state `quranic:root_000429:B001/m01`; handleless cup `quranic:root_001328:B001/m01`; cup with its drink `quranic:root_001277:B001/m01`; running spring `quranic:root_001069:B006/m01`; headache or splitting pain `quranic:root_000850:B007/m01`; loss of reason through intoxication `quranic:root_001491:B003/m01`; exhaustion of drink `quranic:root_001491:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Circulation is closed as choreography but open as supply. The attendants and vessels keep moving around the seated center, while the spring neither runs out nor exacts the cognitive and bodily cost normally associated with drinking.

subchannels.name: Selection joins appetite to provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: Desired nourishment is selected rather than imposed, joining discernment, fruit, hunted flesh, and appetite in one provisioning act.
subchannels.active_motifs: edible fruit `quranic:root_001174:B002/m01`; choosing the preferred good `quranic:root_000452:B003/m01`; edible flesh `quranic:root_001348:B001/m01`; bird in flight `quranic:root_000962:B001/m01`; appetite toward the desired `quranic:root_000825:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The food scene is organized by agency at the point of reception: discernment selects the fruit and appetite selects the flesh. Provision answers a formed desire instead of reducing abundance to sheer quantity.

subchannels.name: Brilliance held inside protection
subchannels.scene_or_process: Contrasting, expansive eyes and pearl-like luminosity are preserved inside a protective casing.
subchannels.active_motifs: intense black-white eye contrast `quranic:root_000369:B001/m01`; wide and beautiful eyes `quranic:root_001069:B016/m01`; pearl as precious object `quranic:root_001337:B001/m01`; pearl-like shining `quranic:root_001337:B002/m01`; protective enclosure `quranic:root_001324:B001/m01`; likeness between forms `quranic:root_001397:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Beauty is rendered as a high-contrast visual object whose brightness survives because it is enclosed. The pearl comparison therefore conveys not only appearance but guarded value and unhandled preservation.

subchannels.name: Compensation closes accusation into peace
subchannels.scene_or_process: Deliberate work receives matching recompense, and the resulting social soundscape excludes discarded or guilt-loading speech in favor of safety and peace.
subchannels.active_motifs: matching recompense `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; intentional work `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`; hearing speech `quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`; discarded speech `quranic:root_001361:B001/m01`; foul or accusatory speech `quranic:root_001361:B002/m01`; loading guilt onto another `quranic:root_000013:B004/m01`; articulated utterance `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; safety from harm `quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`; peace opposed to conflict `quranic:root_000737:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The court's moral economy matches outcome to purposeful action, then removes the verbal mechanisms that reopen conflict: noise without value, obscenity, and imputed guilt. What remains audible is a repeated declaration of intactness and peace.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Recompense is materialized as an ordered court whose enclosure, service, intake, beauty, and speech are protected from decay, depletion, and antagonism.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 56:11-26 presents the near ones, enclosed gardens, arranged seats, circulating servants, food and drink, guarded brilliance, recompense, and peaceful speech.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The scene combines royal access, furnishing craft, controlled circulation, non-depleting consumption, and a regulated speech environment rather than offering an undifferentiated luxury inventory.

parent_channels.name: P2 A Maintained Habitat of Uninterrupted Provision

subchannels.name: Orchard maintenance produces accessible fruit
subchannels.scene_or_process: Thorn removal, green pruning, palm tending, and ordered stacking turn living growth into reachable, edible abundance.
subchannels.active_motifs: removal of thorns `quranic:root_000417:B002/m01`; cutting green growth `quranic:root_000417:B003/m01`; fruit-bearing tree `quranic:root_000944:B001/m01`; stacked natural bodies `quranic:root_001515:B004/m01`; young palms `quranic:root_000248:B006/m01`; palm hearts and shoots `quranic:root_001286:B006/m01`; pruning palm fronds `quranic:root_000996:B018/m01`; edible fruit `quranic:root_001174:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The orchard is latent with labor. Sharpness is removed, wet growth is selectively cut, palm structures are tended, and fruiting bodies are arranged, so ease of access emerges from cultivation rather than from a shapeless mass of vegetation.

subchannels.name: Extended cover and replenished flow block interruption
subchannels.scene_or_process: Shade extends as protective cover while water is delivered and replenished; cessation and obstruction are named only to be negated.
subchannels.active_motifs: shade as cover `quranic:root_000966:B001/m01`; protective shelter `quranic:root_000966:B004/m01`; longitudinal extension `quranic:root_001407:B001/m01`; one water source replenishing another `quranic:root_001407:B003/m01`; water itself `quranic:root_001458:B001/m01`; delivery by watering or pouring `quranic:root_001458:B003/m01`; pouring and surface flow `quranic:root_000723:B001/m01`; cessation of supply `quranic:root_001240:B005/m01`; obstructing barrier `quranic:root_001448:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Canopy and water form one continuity system: cover stretches, water travels, and one body of water can feed another. The negated cutoff and barrier define abundance operationally as provision that remains connected to its users.

subchannels.name: Basin and waterskin keep water serviceable
subchannels.scene_or_process: A basin is founded, a split waterskin is splinted, and water is routed to a designated pouring place.
subchannels.active_motifs: basin sides and foundation `quranic:root_001502:B007/m01`; waterskin repair splint `quranic:root_000723:B010/m01`; delivery of water `quranic:root_001458:B003/m01`; designated pouring or irrigation place `quranic:root_000723:B004/m01`; replenishing flow `quranic:root_001407:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The water scene extends into maintenance technology. Containment begins with the basin's first structural members; portability is preserved by repairing the skin; delivery ends at a prepared locus. The latent mechanism makes uninterrupted water depend on sound interfaces.

subchannels.name: A raised interior is spread, stacked, and tailored
subchannels.scene_or_process: A prepared floor supports bedding and stacked household goods while flowing cloth is cut and fitted into a raised interior.
subchannels.active_motifs: spreading and preparation `quranic:root_001143:B001/m01`; bedding and household furnishing `quranic:root_001143:B002/m01`; physical elevation `quranic:root_000582:B001/m01`; stacked household goods `quranic:root_001515:B002/m01`; furnishing rack or support `quranic:root_001515:B003/m01`; fine flowing cloth `quranic:root_000723:B003/m01`; cutting and tailoring cloth `quranic:root_001240:B012/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Raised bedding belongs to a complete furnishing operation: surfaces are prepared, goods are stacked on supports, and cloth is allowed to flow before being cut to form. The garden's ease therefore acquires an interior architecture.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Blessed abundance appears as a deliberately maintained habitat whose plants, water system, furnishings, and access remain serviceable and unobstructed.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 56:28-35 joins de-thorned and stacked vegetation, extended shade, poured water, uncut fruit, raised bedding, and fresh origination.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The lexical network exposes horticultural maintenance, irrigation hardware, and textile preparation beneath the surface garden.

parent_channels.name: P2 Companionship Remade as Firstness and Parity

subchannels.name: Origination restores youthful firstness
subchannels.scene_or_process: A created form is brought into a new state characterized by youthful growth, beginning, and untouched firstness.
subchannels.active_motifs: creation and origination `quranic:root_001502:B006/m01`; growth and rearing of youth `quranic:root_001502:B002/m01`; making a thing `quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`; transforming it into a state `quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`; first or newly ripened condition `quranic:root_000143:B002/m01`; untouched firstness `quranic:root_000143:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The operation proceeds from origination to transformation. Youth is not merely retained; a new state is deliberately produced, and firstness becomes the condition that marks the result.

subchannels.name: Affection joins equals across temporal cohorts
subchannels.scene_or_process: Loving companionship is organized among equal-age peers and extends to blessed cohorts drawn from both temporal ends.
subchannels.active_motifs: affectionate spouse `quranic:root_000996:B005/m01`; equal-age companion `quranic:root_000178:B004/m01`; companionship and abiding association `quranic:root_000844:B001/m01`; blessing `quranic:root_001698:B001/m01`; gathered cohort `quranic:root_000204:B001/m01`; temporal priority `quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`; later cohort `quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The social unit is neither hierarchy nor ancestry but reciprocal affection among peers. Equal age supplies symmetry, while the two large cohorts show that this relational parity can gather people from opposite ends of historical sequence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A new act of formation removes prior wear and establishes companionship through renewed firstness, affection, and equality of age.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 56:35-40 describes fresh origination, transformed firstness, affectionate peers, and cohorts from both earlier and later peoples.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Creation vocabulary does relational work: it remakes not only bodies but the conditions of mutuality.

parent_channels.name: P3 Heat That Penetrates Shelter and Intake

subchannels.name: A canopy that conducts heat instead of refuge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Encompassing hot wind enters through narrow openings beneath a black overhead cover that withholds both cooling and beneficent shelter.
subchannels.active_motifs: enclosure from all sides `quranic:root_000819:B001/m01`; penetrating hot wind `quranic:root_000743:B004/m01`; narrow bodily openings `quranic:root_000743:B001/m01`; black smoke and soot `quranic:root_000001:B001/m01`; overhead canopy `quranic:root_000966:B003/m01`; cooling and coldness `quranic:root_000103:B001/m01`; beneficent honor `quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`; sweat and heat exposure `quranic:root_000001:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene reverses shelter's function. A cover still encloses, but its material is blackened heat; the wind is defined by its ability to pass through fine openings, and the missing coolness and generosity make the canopy an exposure chamber.

subchannels.name: Solid intake is driven from jaw to overfull belly
subchannels.scene_or_process: Tree matter is taken into an opened jaw, forced toward the throat, and packed into an interior container beyond comfortable fullness.
subchannels.active_motifs: eating `quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`; tree with a trunk `quranic:root_000777:B001/m01`; gap between the jaws `quranic:root_000777:B005/m01`; swallowing to the throat `quranic:root_000636:B002/m01`; filling to vessel capacity `quranic:root_001441:B001/m01`; inner belly or cavity `quranic:root_000128:B001/m01`; overfull or afflicted belly `quranic:root_000128:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The ingestion sequence is mechanically explicit. A branching source becomes mouthful, the jaw becomes an aperture, swallowing drives the material inward, and the belly behaves like a vessel filled to a harmful limit.

subchannels.name: Hot drinking renews rather than resolves thirst
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hot liquid passes through the throat in repeated draughts, while camel disease and absorbent sand model intake that cannot produce satiety.
subchannels.active_motifs: drinking liquid `quranic:root_000783:B001/m01`; throat channels `quranic:root_000783:B006/m01`; heated water `quranic:root_000001:B002/m01`; unquenchable thirst `quranic:root_001614:B001/m01`; dry sand that swallows water `quranic:root_001614:B002/m01`; camel thirst-disease `quranic:root_001614:B003/m01`; hostile guest provision `quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Drinking ceases to be restorative. The throat transmits heated liquid to a body modeled simultaneously as diseased livestock and water-devouring sand, so every draught reproduces the deficit; naming it guest provision completes the inversion of hospitality.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Heat defeats every ordinary boundary: it enters through the air, occupies the would-be shelter, fills the interior body, and converts drinking into further thirst.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 56:41-44 establishes the thermal enclosure, and 56:51-56 carries it through eating, belly-filling, hot drinking, and hostile hospitality.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Pores, jaw-space, throat channels, vessel capacity, absorbent sand, and diseased camels turn punishment into a continuous transport mechanism from atmosphere to interior.

parent_channels.name: P3 Entrenched Denial Meets Scheduled Assembly

subchannels.name: Indulgence hardens into oath and assertion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Unrestricted luxury produces fixed resolve, breached obligation, and repeated false speech.
subchannels.active_motifs: luxury that releases its possessor from restraint `quranic:root_000179:B001/m01`; persistent resolve `quranic:root_000856:B002/m01`; grave sin and deviation `quranic:root_000359:B001/m01`; breach of an oath `quranic:root_000359:B002/m01`; articulated claim `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; falsehood opposed to truth `quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Ease is shown as a social condition that removes constraint, after which persistence becomes an operation: resolve is tied, obligation is broken, and the resulting assertion is held against contradiction.

subchannels.name: Dormant bodily material is roused
subchannels.scene_or_process: Lost life, soil, and hard bone are treated as a recumbent state from which prior generations can be stirred.
subchannels.active_motifs: loss of life and force `quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`; soil and dust `quranic:root_000178:B001/m01`; hard bone `quranic:root_001029:B005/m01`; rousing a sleeper or recumbent animal `quranic:root_000129:B001/m01`; fathers and progenitors `quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`; temporal priority `quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The denied transformation is lexically less like rebuilding from nothing than awakening something laid down. Dust and bone are the dormant material, while بعث supplies the kinetic reversal from recumbency to movement.

subchannels.name: All temporal ends converge at a fixed appointment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Earlier and later populations are collected into one assembly whose time, severe day, and accounting function are fixed and known.
subchannels.active_motifs: temporal priority `quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`; later population `quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`; collecting dispersed persons `quranic:root_000259:B001/m01`; fixing a temporal limit `quranic:root_001671:B002/m01`; appointed meeting time `quranic:root_001671:B003/m01`; severe event-day `quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`; known fact `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; reckoning and requital `quranic:root_000504:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Sequence collapses into simultaneity: first and last lose their temporal separation when collection places them under one known limit. The appointment is therefore both calendar and court, a time that gathers in order to account.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A self-reinforcing stance of indulgence and denial is answered by the equally firm but external order of reanimation, collection, and appointed reckoning.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 56:45-51 moves from luxury and persistence through denial of resurrection to the collection of first and last at a known appointment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The contrast is not simply belief versus disbelief; it is one fixation of will displaced by a stronger fixation of time, place, and bodily reassembly.

parent_channels.name: P4 Life as Measured Generation and Replaceable Form

subchannels.name: Reproductive material is calibrated into form and duration
subchannels.scene_or_process: Emitted reproductive material enters a process of prior measurement, creation, formal completion, allotted lifespan, and inescapable end.
subchannels.active_motifs: seminal material from which form is measured `quranic:root_001450:B002/m01`; measuring before cutting or acting `quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`; origination of a created thing `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; completed and balanced form `quranic:root_000434:B003/m01`; amount and terminal limit `quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`; planned calibration `quranic:root_001205:B005/m01`; interval distributed among parties `quranic:root_000170:B002/m01`; loss of life `quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`; failure to outrun a pursuer `quranic:root_000671:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Generation is portrayed as more than emission. The material is measured before form, completed into a balanced body, and assigned a bounded interval; death is the limit that cannot be outrun, making lifespan part of the original calibration.

subchannels.name: Replacement preserves relation while changing form
subchannels.scene_or_process: One bearer can stand in another's place, an image can change while relation remains, and a new origination can follow the first.
subchannels.active_motifs: one thing standing in another's place `quranic:root_000095:B001/m01`; change of outward form `quranic:root_000095:B002/m01`; likeness or counterpart `quranic:root_001397:B001/m01`; fresh origination `quranic:root_001502:B006/m01`; disclosed knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; first in sequence `quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`; recollection after forgetting `quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Substitution does not require simple duplication. A counterpart preserves intelligible relation while alteration changes the presented form; knowledge of the first origination supplies the model by which another can be remembered as possible.

subchannels.name: Human seed and agricultural seed share a generative frame
subchannels.scene_or_process: Semen functions as seed, descends as reproductive fluid, begins pregnancy, and becomes visible in the body.
subchannels.active_motifs: male seed as crop seed `quranic:root_000630:B004/m01`; seminal material `quranic:root_001450:B002/m01`; emitted male fluid `quranic:root_001492:B009/m01`; onset of pregnancy `quranic:root_001502:B009/m01`; visible signs of pregnancy `quranic:root_000531:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The lexical field explicitly joins the reproductive and agricultural demonstrations. Seed is cast in both womb and soil, pregnancy is the hidden onset of growth, and visible enlargement is the point at which an unseen generative process declares itself.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Embodied life is a measured production whose material, duration, form, and replacement remain under an agency beyond its human transmitters.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 56:57-62 interrogates creation from emitted fluid, apportions death, and asserts replacement and another origination from the known first one.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Measuring leather before cutting, reproductive seed, visible pregnancy, and substitution of forms make creation legible as calibrated manufacture without reducing it to mechanism alone.

parent_channels.name: P4 Provision Chains Humans Use but Do Not Originate

subchannels.name: Field labor can terminate in harvest or ruin
subchannels.scene_or_process: Seed is cast into worked ground and grown, but the crop can be broken into dry fragments, converting expected gain into persistent loss and deprivation.
subchannels.active_motifs: casting seed and preparing soil `quranic:root_000303:B002/m01`; trampled and worked ground `quranic:root_000303:B008/m01`; growing a crop `quranic:root_000630:B001/m01`; breaking dry matter into fragments `quranic:root_000337:B001/m01`; famine that breaks people and property `quranic:root_000337:B003/m01`; financial liability `quranic:root_001081:B001/m01`; abiding ruin `quranic:root_001081:B003/m01`; deprivation of an expected good `quranic:root_000313:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The field scene separates labor from outcome. Humans can disturb earth and cast seed, but growth can be reversed into brittle debris; at that point agricultural failure becomes an economic relation of liability and an existential state of being shut out.

subchannels.name: Cloud delivery can become drink or brine
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water is gathered in cloud, sent downward for drinking, and remains subject to conversion into bitter salinity; gratitude answers the contingency of the chain.
subchannels.active_motifs: water itself `quranic:root_001458:B001/m01`; rain cloud `quranic:root_001419:B001/m01`; causing a thing to descend and arrive `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; intensely saline and bitter water `quranic:root_000014:B003/m01`; recognition of a benefaction `quranic:root_000810:B001/m01`; flourishing from little input `quranic:root_000810:B002/m01`; intensified rain `quranic:root_000810:B005/m01`; cloud that nurtures vegetation `quranic:root_000532:B008/m01`

parent_channels.surprising_reach: Debt, famine, cloud husbandry, minimal-input flourishing, tinder, and traveler supplies expose the operational dependencies inside ordinary provision.

parent_channels.name: P4 Demonstration Becomes Remembrance and Naming

subchannels.name: Seeing is an interrogative operation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Visual attention is repeatedly redirected into deliberation, disclosure, knowledge, and recollection.
subchannels.active_motifs: sensory seeing `quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`; reflective judgment `quranic:root_000531:B002/m01`; interrogative “tell me” `quranic:root_000531:B013/m01`; disclosed knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; recollection after forgetting `quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`; reminder that restores presence `quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The refrain does not request passive looking. Each familiar object is made to answer a question about agency, so perception becomes reasoning; repeated demonstrations accumulate into remembered knowledge.

subchannels.name: Recognition resolves into an elevated name
subchannels.scene_or_process: The sustaining owner and cultivator is named, elevated, and declared beyond defect.

subchannels.synthesis: The sequence of demonstrations ends in a compact verbal act. The name identifies the owner of the processes, lordship gathers their nurture and completion, greatness raises their scale, and glorification removes any attribution of defect.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Repeated attention to familiar processes is converted into reflective knowledge, recollection, and a final act of naming and magnifying their sustaining Lord.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the repeated `أَفَرَءَيْتُم` of 56:58, 63, 68, and 71 culminates in remembrance at 56:73 and glorification at 56:74.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sight operates as interrogation, deliberation, and disclosure; naming is not a label added afterward but the verbal completion of demonstrated dependence.

parent_channels.name: P5 Ordered Placement and Guarded Transmission

subchannels.name: Celestial positions establish an attestive order
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rising stars occupy fixed falling or landing positions, and an oath marks the magnitude of an order available to knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: oath `quranic:root_001226:B004/m01`; falling and fixation in place `quranic:root_001675:B001/m01`; stars and celestial stations `quranic:root_001475:B001/m01`; rising into visibility `quranic:root_001475:B002/m01`; prominent marker or path `quranic:root_001475:B006/m01`; disclosed knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; magnitude and power `quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The oath points to a patterned sky in which appearance and placement coincide. Stars rise as visible markers yet are known through their stations, so celestial order becomes the attestive frame for the textual order that follows.

subchannels.name: Recitation is gathered into a stitched enclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech is gathered and recited, joined into writing, and held in a protective book casing.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathering components `quranic:root_001210:B001/m01`; reading and recitation `quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`; noble excellence `quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`; joining and stitching leather `quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`; ordered writing `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; protective casing `quranic:root_001324:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Reading gathers utterance; writing joins signs; bookmaking joins material edges; enclosure preserves the assembled result. The latent stitched-codex scene gives physical form to the movement from recited plurality to guarded unity.

subchannels.name: Cleansed contact governs descent and access
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bodily contact is conditioned by cleansing, while the text itself arrives through an ordered act of delivery from its sovereign source.
subchannels.active_motifs: tactile contact `quranic:root_001423:B001/m01`; purity from defilement `quranic:root_000953:B001/m01`; washing with water `quranic:root_000953:B003/m01`; sending down and delivering `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; lordship and ownership `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Access is neither casual handling nor self-authorized possession. Cleansing regulates the receiver's contact, while descent regulates the text's direction of arrival; both sides of transmission are ordered by the source's ownership.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Authority is expressed through exact placement, gathered inscription, protective enclosure, and controlled contact during transmission.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 56:75-80 moves from star positions and oath to a noble recitation in a concealed book, restricted touch, and descent from the Lord.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Cosmic location and codex manufacture share an invariant of components put in place; stitching, casing, washing, and delivery materialize textual preservation.

parent_channels.name: P5 Authoritative Register and Final Settlement

subchannels.name: Shares and obligations enter the register
subchannels.scene_or_process: Portions are divided, names and decrees are entered into a record, allotted provision is issued, and debt comes due for reckoning.
subchannels.active_motifs: division into shares `quranic:root_001226:B003/m01`; binding decree `quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`; entry of a name in a register `quranic:root_001283:B004/m01`; allotted provision `quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`; edible maintenance `quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`; financial debt `quranic:root_000504:B003/m01`; reckoning and requital `quranic:root_000504:B002/m01`; a claimant's specific right `quranic:root_000347:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The same network that divides an oath's burden can allocate a share, enter a person in a register, and establish an obligation. Provision and judgment are thus not unrelated themes: one issues what is apportioned, the other settles what remains due.

subchannels.name: Contested assertion becomes demonstrated certainty
subchannels.scene_or_process: False and true claims are opposed, tested by action, established as fixed reality, and brought beyond doubt.
subchannels.active_motifs: truth-matching speech `quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`; fulfillment that proves a claim `quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`; falsehood `quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`; reality fixed against falsehood `quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`; binding necessity `quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`; establishment and disclosure of truth `quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`; knowledge with doubt removed `quranic:root_001696:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Truth moves through stages: assertion, practical test, establishment, and certainty. The death challenge supplies the test, while the closing formula states the result as both objectively fixed and subjectively beyond doubt.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Allotted provision, recorded obligation, judgment, and verified truth form one administrative scene in which claims are entered and finally settled.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 56:75-82 supplies oath, book, provision, and denial, while 56:86-87 and 56:95 name judgment, truthfulness, fixed truth, and certainty.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The book can function simultaneously as inscription and register, while provision becomes an allotted share and judgment becomes the settlement of debt and right.

parent_channels.name: P5 The Death Threshold Tests Claimed Autonomy

subchannels.name: Looking cannot cross the terminal boundary
subchannels.scene_or_process: Life reaches the throat at its appointed time while observers look and wait, yet fail to perceive what is closer than they are.
subchannels.active_motifs: arrival at a terminal limit `quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`; throat and breath passage `quranic:root_000350:B001/m01`; appointed time `quranic:root_000382:B001/m01`; moment of death `quranic:root_000382:B002/m01`; directed looking `quranic:root_001520:B001/m01`; waiting for the moment `quranic:root_001520:B002/m01`; spatial or relational nearness `quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`; physical sight `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; inward insight `quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The body's upper passage becomes a boundary of knowledge. Human eyes remain open and directed, but proximity does not guarantee perception; the closest presence lies beyond the observers' visual reach.

subchannels.name: Failed return demonstrates subjection
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claim to stand outside judgment is tested by ordering the departing life to return; inability to restore it falsifies autonomy.
subchannels.active_motifs: being other than or outside a class `quranic:root_001119:B005/m01`; subjugation and compelled rule `quranic:root_000504:B004/m01`; return to a prior state `quranic:root_000544:B001/m01`; truth-matching assertion `quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`; fulfillment that proves a claim `quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`; occurrence in a state `quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Freedom from judgment is not debated abstractly. It is operationalized as control over reversal: if the observers are truly unruled, they should restore what has reached the terminal boundary. Their failure discloses the stronger relation of subjection.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: At the body's terminal boundary, visible observation fails to reach the nearest agency, and inability to reverse the passage exposes subjection to judgment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 56:83-87 stages the soul at the throat, watching without sight, hidden proximity, claimed freedom from judgment, and the failed command to return it.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The scene distinguishes looking from insight and spatial closeness from perceptibility, then converts a metaphysical claim into a practical reversal test.

parent_channels.name: P5 Terminal Classification as Reception

subchannels.name: The near are received by breath, rest, and growth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Royal intimates enter a reception of breeze, fragrance, restored breath, vegetation, enclosure, and ease.
subchannels.active_motifs: royal intimates `quranic:root_001212:B004/m01`; breeze and moving air `quranic:root_000609:B003/m01`; fragrance and scent `quranic:root_000609:B004/m01`; rest after exhaustion `quranic:root_000609:B007/m01`; fragrant vegetation `quranic:root_000609:B012/m01`; tree-screened garden `quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`; good and easeful state `quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Nearness is answered by a breathable habitat. Air, scent, rest, and plant growth form one restorative ecology inside the garden enclosure, reversing the constricted throat and failed human breath of the preceding scene.

subchannels.name: Right-hand companionship arrives as peace
subchannels.scene_or_process: Blessed side, durable association, and freedom from harm converge in a greeting exchanged among companions.
subchannels.active_motifs: companionship and association `quranic:root_000844:B001/m01`; blessing `quranic:root_001698:B001/m01`; right side `quranic:root_001698:B002/m01`; safety from harm `quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`; peace opposed to conflict `quranic:root_000737:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The second reception is social rather than architectural. Side identifies the blessed company, companionship supplies mutual belonging, and the greeting makes safety audible as the relation holding that company together.

subchannels.name: Deniers receive predatory hospitality

subchannels.name: Certain reception order elicits glorification
subchannels.scene_or_process: The threefold outcome is declared fixed and doubtless, then answered by naming and exonerating its sovereign source.
subchannels.active_motifs: reality fixed against falsehood `quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`; knowledge with doubt removed `quranic:root_001696:B001/m01`; transcendence and exoneration `quranic:root_000666:B002/m01`; name as public designation `quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`; lordship and ownership `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`; magnitude and power `quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Classification closes as epistemic and liturgical certainty. Its reality is fixed, doubt is removed, and the appropriate response is to name the Lord, magnify the scale of the order, and clear its source of defect.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Death resolves identity into one of three receptions, each expressed through a distinct hospitality, social relation, and bodily environment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 56:88-96 assigns rest and garden to the near, peace to the right-hand companions, and hot provision and flame to deniers before sealing the division as certain truth.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Breeze, scent, plant, greeting, guest provision, and thermal exposure make classification experiential; the closing glorification treats that reception order as a disclosed reality.

parent_channels.name: P1-P5 Directed Transmission from Disclosure to Arrival

subchannels.name: A report is released, heard, and blocked from its subject
subchannels.scene_or_process: A report is disclosed, broadcast from its source, and made audible to others, while paired formulas seek to prevent the unwelcome news from reaching the person concerned.
subchannels.active_motifs: disclosure and public showing `quranic:root_000299:B006/m01`; broadcasting a report from its speaker `quranic:root_000582:B005/m01`; causing another to hear `quranic:root_000741:B004/m01`; wish that bad news be heard but not reach its subject `quranic:root_000741:B011/m01`, `quranic:root_000151:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Across P1, P2, and P5, the bridge is a causal transmission sequence: disclosure, broadcast, caused hearing, and attempted non-arrival. Human agents may try to control whether ordinary news reaches its addressee; that failed-delivery formula usefully pressures the primary reading, in which neither the discourse nor the report enacted at death can be kept from its terminal subject.

subchannels.name: Scout, courier, and marked route
subchannels.scene_or_process: A scout gathers intelligence, a dispatcher sends a messenger, the courier travels a road, and visible markers, standards, and a beacon guide the movement to its destination.
subchannels.active_motifs: scout or spy sent to gather news `quranic:root_001069:B005/m01`; dispatching a messenger or force toward a purpose `quranic:root_000129:B002/m01`; courier and postal movement along a road `quranic:root_000103:B004/m01`; road marker and distinguishing boundary `quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`; raised visible standard `quranic:root_000531:B011/m01`; beacon or landmark guiding the route `quranic:root_001564:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Across P1, P3, P4, and P5, the bridge is a role progression: observer, dispatcher, carrier, route marker, and visible destination. The scene materializes resurrection's dispatch and the surah's transmission language as movement with an assigned end, not diffuse motion or a message without an addressee.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What is sent becomes effective through a directed chain from source and disclosure through carrier, channel, marked route, and intended reception.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; P1 regulates what is heard and said at 56:25-26, P2 contributes the elevation lexeme at 56:34, P3 names dispatch at resurrection and a known appointment at 56:47-50, P4 repeatedly stages seeing and recognition at 56:58-71, and P5 presents sent-down discourse beside the death threshold at 56:75-83.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Oral publication and physical courier movement share one delivery architecture; the wish that unwelcome news be heard without reaching its subject isolates failed arrival as the reversal of successful transmission.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1 Mounted Approach to an Inexhaustible Water Source
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Mounts are gently driven, lowered for mounting, accelerated into a race, and brought by night to a spring where water is lifted and given at their mouths.

parent_channels.name: S3. P1 Parturition and Sustained Milk
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A near-term animal enters labor and gives birth while milk thickens, is retained in the udder, and is tested against failure of supply.
parent_channels.active_motifs: nearness of delivery `quranic:root_001212:B012/m01`; laboring camel `quranic:root_001678:B006/m01`; occurrence of birth `quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`; milk retained in the udder `quranic:root_000582:B007/m01`; thick milk before birth `quranic:root_001174:B004/m01`; milk that fails to last `quranic:root_001290:B006/m01`

parent_channels.name: S4. P4 Controlled Cooking Transformation
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A pot is handled with a heat cloth, exposed to kindled flame, and used to soften or reduce the force of its contents into a thick preparation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: cloth for lowering a pot from fire `quranic:root_000248:B007/m01`; cooking pot `quranic:root_001205:B007/m01`; weakening by cooking `quranic:root_001454:B002/m01`; blaze and intense heat `quranic:root_000014:B002/m01`; burning fire `quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`; kindling latent fire `quranic:root_001642:B002/m01`; thick syrup used in food preparation `quranic:root_000532:B006/m01`

parent_channels.name: S5. P5 Fresh Discourse Coated into Denial
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A newly occurring message is treated with an oily surface of accommodating speech while allotted nourishment is verbally converted into denial.
parent_channels.active_motifs: coming into being after absence `quranic:root_000299:B001/m01`; renewed report or discourse `quranic:root_000299:B003/m01`; oil used as coating `quranic:root_000497:B001/m01`; soft dissimulation that shows other than the inward state `quranic:root_000497:B002/m01`; allotted provision `quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`; edible maintenance `quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`; falsehood opposed to truth `quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The message's freshness is met not by open rejection alone but by a coating operation: outward softness masks the inner stance. The next move is more severe, turning the very share that sustains the hearer into material for denying its source.

parent_channels.name: S6. P5 Contact, Gestation, and Purification as Bodily Enclosure
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Sexual contact begins a concealed gestation in a womb that gathers material; the cycle includes menstrual timing, purification, new emergence, and the possibility of a pregnancy that returns or fails.

The scene gives P5's guarded contact and concealed transmission an unexpectedly embodied analogue.

parent_channels.name: S7. Wagered Horse Race and Ordered Finish

The activation materializes the foremost and the surah's threefold sorting as an ordered finish, while usefully pressuring that analogy: final placement is not a negotiable wager or a race that can be rerun.

parent_channels.name: S8. Conditioning and Filling a Waterskin
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A waterskin is prepared with clay and water to improve its taste and seal its stitching, then filled for carrying or drawing water.

parent_channels.name: S9. Grain Formation, Harvest, and Threshing-Floor Delivery
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Grain forms and thickens in the crop, the crop is harvested, and the cut yield is carried to the threshing floor.

parent_channels.synthesis: The scene supplies the successful endpoint latent beside 56:63-65: formed grain can be cut and delivered for processing. parent_channels.name: S10. Fire-Drill Kindling and Heat-Straightening
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A rod is worked in a hollow firestick to kindle flame; fuel is fed and stirred until the maintained heat can straighten another staff.

parent_channels.synthesis: The motifs trace one controlled mechanism from ignition tool through sustained heat to a straightened object. This materializes 56:71-73 by showing fire as both a produced flame and a transforming utility, while leaving the tree and the fire-bearing capacity on which the craft depends outside human manufacture.

parent_channels.name: S11. Grave Excavation and Right-Side Burial
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Grave earth is excavated, the dead person is shrouded and concealed, the body is laid on its right side, and the earth is returned.
parent_channels.active_motifs: grave earth dug out and heaped back `quranic:root_000204:B003/m01`; shrouding and concealing the dead in a grave `quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`; laying the dead on the right side `quranic:root_001698:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Excavation, shrouding, bodily orientation, and returned earth form a burial rite that materializes the death threshold of 56:83-96. The right-hand vocabulary gains an embodied resonance, while burial as concealment usefully pressures the equation of return to earth with annihilation.

parent_channels.name: S12. Rumor, Feud, and Negotiated Truce
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Tale-bearing corrupts relations and ignites a feud; ties are severed until a mediator intervenes, a truce is concluded, and social connection is restored.
parent_channels.active_motifs: tale-bearing that incites corruption between people `quranic:root_000043:B009/m01`; feud and hostility between groups `quranic:root_001564:B007/m01`; severed relations `quranic:root_001240:B007/m01`; mediation and reconciliation between opponents `quranic:root_000743:B005/m01`; formal truce `quranic:root_001226:B008/m01`; restored social bond `quranic:root_000170:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The activation gives speech a complete social consequence: incitement produces hostility and rupture, while mediation moves the parties through truce back into relation. It reframes the repeated `peace, peace` of 56:26 as repaired social order, materializing why corrupt and sinful speech is absent from that company.

parent_channels.name: S13. Joint Livestock Buyout and Replacement
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Co-owners assess a camel that has reached carrying or riding age, approximate its quality and price, bid until one partner buys the others' shares, and may sell it to purchase a replacement.
parent_channels.active_motifs: camel reaching the age for carrying or riding `quranic:root_000347:B008/m01`; approximate quality and price `quranic:root_001212:B016/m01`; competitive valuation and buyout among co-owners `quranic:root_001274:B004/m01`; sale followed by purchase of a replacement `quranic:root_000544:B011/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Maturity assessment, negotiated price, transfer of shares, and substitution form one ordinary property transaction. It usefully pressures 56:85-95: owned property can be appraised, transferred, sold, and replaced, but those who claim independence at the deathbed cannot buy back or return the departing life; true certainty is not a negotiable valuation.

parent_channels.name: S14. Prayer Staged for an Audience
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A worshipper performs prayer and glorification but stages deathlike humility so the act will be seen, heard, and converted into public acclaim.
parent_channels.active_motifs: obligatory prayer through standing, bowing, and prostration `quranic:root_000880:B001/m01`; worship and thanksgiving through glorification `quranic:root_000666:B001/m01`; honor and public acclaim `quranic:root_000516:B007/m01`; reputation circulated for people to hear `quranic:root_000741:B005/m01`; action performed to be seen by people `quranic:root_000531:B005/m01`; feigned deathlike humility `quranic:root_001454:B011/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Bodily prayer, glorification, visible abasement, and the pursuit of reputation form one performative rite. The scene usefully pressures the closing commands of 56:74 and 56:96: glorification answers the surah's certainty only when directed to the named Lord rather than managed for a human audience.

parent_channels.name: S15. Predatory Breach of a Herd
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A wolf-hyena predator reaches vulnerable small livestock, reduces an animal to prey, and ravages the herd's living wealth.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wolf-hyena hybrid predator `quranic:root_000741:B010/m01`; young or small livestock vulnerable to slaughter `quranic:root_001143:B004/m01`; animal isolated for eating or taken as a predator's prey `quranic:root_000043:B007/m01`; predatory ravaging of livestock `quranic:root_000337:B006/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene makes eating an event of violent dispossession: protected herd wealth becomes vulnerable prey. It usefully pressures the surah's food polarity, contrasting freely chosen provision with P3's coerced eating and showing how judgment can invert secure sustenance into exposure and loss.

parent_channels.name: S16. Polished Blade, Concealed Carry, and Draw
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A sword is polished, placed in its scabbard, concealed beneath clothing, and deliberately drawn when the hand returns to the weapon.
parent_channels.active_motifs: polishing a sword clear of rust `quranic:root_000299:B007/m01`; sword scabbard or leather sheath `quranic:root_001212:B010/m01`; short sword concealed beneath a garment `quranic:root_000819:B005/m01`; reaching for and drawing the weapon `quranic:root_000544:B010/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Polishing, enclosure, concealed carriage, and deliberate access form one weapon-handling sequence. It reframes P5's protected-book and contact sequence as controlled access to a prepared edge: enclosure preserves rather than neutralizes force, deepening the contrast between a guarded, potent discourse and its dismissive treatment.

parent_channels.name: S17. P1-P5 The Approaching Event Casts Its Shadow
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An event draws near and throws its shadow ahead of itself; darkness covers the route, the night road becomes forbidding, the appointed interval ripens, and approach resolves into presence.
parent_channels.active_motifs: promise, account, or hour approaching as a thing reaches its end `quranic:root_001212:B002/m01`; approaching event or person casting a shadow `quranic:root_000966:B005/m01`; night covering a thing in darkness `quranic:root_000266:B002/m01`; dangerous night roads one refrains from entering `quranic:root_000313:B009/m01`; appointed need or time coming or being delayed `quranic:root_001210:B005/m01`; need or event drawing near and becoming present `quranic:root_000001:B006/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Across P1, P2, P3, P4, and P5, the bridge is a repeated approach signature: temporal nearness becomes an environmental shadow, constrains movement, and ends as unavoidable presence. The activation reframes the opening Event as an arrival already structuring the surah before it is fully present, while P5 repeats the same signature as death draws close.

parent_channels.name: S18. P1-P4-P5 Convalescence and the Irreversible Threshold
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Illness reaches a severe point, the patient turns toward improvement, and health returns after wasting; terminal death provides the contrasting threshold from which observers cannot restore the person.
parent_channels.active_motifs: illness becoming severe `quranic:root_000151:B008/m01`; patient convalescing and turning toward improvement `quranic:root_001397:B012/m01`; recovery and health after wasting `quranic:root_000152:B003/m01`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 56:23 `أَمْثَٰلِ`; 56:61 `أَمْثَٰلَ`; 56:83 `بَلَغَتِ`; unavailable for `quranic:root_000152:B003/m01` because root `ب ل ل` is missing from surface root coverage
parent_channels.synthesis: Across P1, P4, and P5, the bridge is a contrastive reversal: crisis can turn into convalescence and restored health, whereas the deathbed challenge at 56:83-87 defeats every attempted return. The medical trajectory materializes what makes the terminal boundary decisive by distinguishing it from a severe but reversible bodily state.

parent_channels.name: S19. P1/P3/P4/P5 False Charge, Immediate Seizure, and Surety
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Eating or drinking is falsely attributed to another person, an authority rules arbitrarily, action follows without delay, the accused is seized, and another person stands as surety.
parent_channels.active_motifs: false charge of eating and enabling another against the accused `quranic:root_000043:B010/m01`; false charge of drinking or another unperformed act `quranic:root_000783:B010/m01`; arbitrary rule over another person `quranic:root_001272:B010/m01`; acting without delay `quranic:root_001290:B005/m01`; taking a person captive `quranic:root_000737:B013/m01`; standing surety for another `quranic:root_001332:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Across P1, P3, P4, and P5, the bridge is a causal forensic sequence and role progression: accuser, self-authorized judge, captive, and guarantor. The scene usefully pressures the surah's final judgment by contrast: human accusation can invent conduct and seize immediately, whereas the closing classification is grounded in certain truth and cannot be evaded through a surety.

parent_channels.name: S20. P1-P5 Death Turns a Person into Circulating Reputation
parent_channels.scene_or_process: After a person's death, public talk turns that person into a circulating story that can be repeated, used as an example, mocked, or attacked in absence.
parent_channels.active_motifs: one manner or state of death `quranic:root_001454:B008/m01`; public talk circulating among people `quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`; person becoming a story or report among people `quranic:root_000299:B004/m01`; fault-finding and backbiting a person `quranic:root_001675:B013/m01`; making sport of people's honor `quranic:root_001174:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Across P1, P2, P3, P4, and P5, the bridge is a role reversal: the mortal speaker becomes the absent object of other people's speech. This unstable, attackable afterlife in reputation usefully contrasts with the surah's terminal classification, where reception is fixed by certain truth rather than by whatever account the living circulate.

parent_channels.name: S21. Scheduled Milking from Udder to Vessels
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A milch camel's teats are secured, pasture fills the udder, a milking time is appointed, the calf is called gently to induce letdown, a milker takes the specified side, and three vessels receive the yield.
parent_channels.active_motifs: cord tied around a camel's teats `quranic:root_000856:B001/m01`; full udder and abundant milk after pasture `quranic:root_000810:B003/m01`; setting a specific milking time `quranic:root_000382:B003/m01`; gently calling the calf to induce milk letdown `quranic:root_000115:B002/m01`; one of two milkers approaching from a specified side `quranic:root_000170:B009/m01`; camel filling three vessels at milking `quranic:root_000203:B005/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Restraint, pasture, timing, induced letdown, bodily position, and filled vessels make one extraction procedure. It materializes the provision and agency arguments of P1 and P4: people can schedule, coax, and collect milk, but they do not make the pasture, udder, or abundance on which the yield depends.

parent_channels.name: S22. Consecration, Offering, and Release at Mina
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A pilgrim enters the protected sanctuary in consecration, assumes the pilgrim garment, gathers at the appointed stations, presents an offering, and reaches the designated place at Mina where shaving closes the rite.
parent_channels.active_motifs: sanctuary and its protected spatial rights `quranic:root_000313:B003/m01`; entering consecration for pilgrimage `quranic:root_000313:B004/m01`; consecrated pilgrim's garment `quranic:root_000313:B010/m01`; gathering at Muzdalifah or during the days at Mina `quranic:root_000259:B004/m01`; sacrificial offering made to seek nearness `quranic:root_001212:B005/m01`; designated place and day for shaving at Mina `quranic:root_000350:B013/m01`; shaving and removing the hair `quranic:root_000350:B002/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Bounded entry, changed dress, appointed gathering, offering, and shaving form a complete passage into and out of ritual consecration. The sequence materializes P5's protected contact, appointment, and nearness, while usefully pressing the distinction between nearness pursued through a human rite and the final nearness granted by sovereign reception.

parent_channels.name: S23. Written Manumission by Instalments
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An enslaved person and owner set scheduled payments for freedom, complete and sign the document, enter the corresponding debtor-creditor relation, face collection of what is due, and reach release when the liability can be discharged.
parent_channels.active_motifs: contract for freedom through scheduled instalments `quranic:root_001283:B005/m01`; signature or notation completing a document `quranic:root_001675:B011/m01`; reciprocal attachment of debtor and creditor `quranic:root_001081:B002/m01`; demanding and collecting a debt `quranic:root_000244:B003/m01`; solvency and capacity to discharge what is due `quranic:root_001441:B008/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Written terms, signature, attached liability, collection, and discharge form a complete legal-economic release mechanism. It usefully pressures P5's `غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ`: human bondage can end through documented payments, but terminal subjection cannot be bought out, renegotiated, or reversed by returning the departing life.

parent_channels.name: S24. Wine Cup with Song and Percussion
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Wine is served in a cup while a singer and percussion or pipes furnish the drinking gathering's sound.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wine `quranic:root_000609:B015/m01`; drinking from a cup `quranic:root_001328:B005/m01`; pleasant song or singer `quranic:root_000741:B007/m01`; drum, tambour, or pipes `quranic:root_001328:B002/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Drink, vessel, singer, and instrument constitute one concrete entertainment scene. It usefully contrasts with P1's circulating cups and disciplined soundscape: the heavenly company retains service and fellowship while removing the intoxication, headache, idle speech, and sin that accompany the ordinary drinking performance.

parent_channels.name: S25. Trained Falconry from Jesses to Verified Quarry
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A falcon is held by its leg jesses, the equipped hunters set out, the bird takes game that becomes meat and ration, and the struck quarry is checked to determine whether it has died.
parent_channels.active_motifs: falcon or hawk `quranic:root_001040:B006/m01`; leather or string jesses fastened to a raptor's legs `quranic:root_000671:B003/m01`; hunters setting out with hunting gear `quranic:root_000745:B006/m01`; game serving as meat for the hunter and ration for the falcon `quranic:root_001348:B003/m01`; checking whether struck quarry has died `quranic:root_001454:B014/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Bird, restraint, equipped pursuit, captured game, and death verification make a complete hunting operation. It materializes P1's bird meat by contrast: ordinary provision requires control, pursuit, killing, and inspection, whereas the selected meat of the garden arrives without that predatory labor chain.

parent_channels.name: S26. Chief Mariner Directs a Sail Crossing
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A chief mariner directs a ship and its tender, the sail is hoisted, vessels approach or depart, and the crew crosses the water boundary.
parent_channels.active_motifs: chief of sailors `quranic:root_000532:B017/m01`; small boat or tender accompanying larger ships `quranic:root_001212:B011/m01`; hoisting a ship's sail `quranic:root_001502:B001/m01`; ships approaching and departing `quranic:root_001502:B008/m01`; crossing a river or other water `quranic:root_001240:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Command, tender, raised sail, vessel movement, and crossing form one navigated passage. The scene materializes an ordinary boundary made traversable by craft and direction, thereby usefully contrasting with P5's death boundary, which nearby witnesses can neither cross nor reverse.

parent_channels.name: S27. Deep Wound from Penetration to Healing
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A wound penetrates to the layer over skull or bone, blood drains until the injured person weakens, pus develops, and new flesh closes the injury.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wound or stab reaching the layer over skull or bone `quranic:root_001143:B011/m01`; blood draining until weakness `quranic:root_001491:B002/m01`; wound developing or extending pus `quranic:root_001407:B007/m01`; wound reaching flesh and then re-fleshing, closing, or healing `quranic:root_001348:B008/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Penetration, blood loss, suppuration, and granulation form a complete progression from injury toward repair. It supports the creation and restoration argument by making severe bodily renewal concrete, while contrasting that repairable state with P5's terminal threshold, beyond which ordinary healing does not return life.

parent_channels.name: S28. Shaded Rain Pool as a Natural Mirror
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Rainwater collects in a rock depression or ground basin, tree shade preserves the small pool, and its crystal-clear surface reflects the viewer's visible appearance.
parent_channels.active_motifs: rock depression or newly dug well catching rainwater `quranic:root_000434:B011/m01`; basin or patch of ground holding water `quranic:root_001675:B008/m01`; shaded water beneath trees or a small pool `quranic:root_000966:B008/m01`; crystal-like or mirror-like clarity `quranic:root_001458:B007/m01`; mirror and visible appearance `quranic:root_000531:B006/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Catchment, shade, clarity, reflection, and appearance make one natural optical scene. It reframes P4's repeated "Have you seen?" questions: a surface can make effects visible while concealing their source, so the interrogation presses beyond appearance toward the agency that produces water, growth, and fire.

parent_channels.name: S29. Termite-Damaged Support, Collapse, and Repair
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Termites eat an interlocked wooden support, the structure loses integrity and collapses, and an order is given to repair what broke.
parent_channels.active_motifs: interlocked or load-bearing wood used in a door, well, bed, or house `quranic:root_000777:B004/m01`; termite eating wood `quranic:root_000025:B010/m01`; house or other thing losing structure and collapsing `quranic:root_000204:B004/m01`; ordering repair of a broken or collapsed thing `quranic:root_000204:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Hidden infestation, failed support, collapse, and commissioned repair form one material failure sequence. It supplies a human-scale analogue for P1's impact and P4's replacement argument: ordinary collapse can be diagnosed and repaired, but the total Event and the recreation of the dead exceed structural maintenance.

parent_channels.name: S30. Heated Bath, Depilation, and Perfuming
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Water is heated in a bathhouse vessel, the body is washed, a lime depilatory is applied, perfume is ground on a broad stone, and the prepared fragrance is spread on the body.
parent_channels.active_motifs: built bathhouse and small vessel for heating water `quranic:root_000001:B013/m01`; purifying water and its cleansing vessel or tool `quranic:root_000953:B004/m01`; lime depilatory coating `quranic:root_001564:B009/m01`; broad stone used to pound perfume `quranic:root_000880:B009/m01`; prepared perfume mixture applied as a coating `quranic:root_000434:B010/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Heated water, washing, depilation, grinding, and anointing make a complete body-care sequence. It materializes P5's purity and fragrant reception as effects humans ordinarily manufacture with heat, vessels, minerals, and tools, while the final rest, purity, and fragrance are received rather than produced.
